artworks.title: Perseus with the Head of Medusa
artworks.description: Cellini's bronze in the Loggia dei Lanzi catches the hero at the moment after the beheading — Medusa's severed head held high, the winged sandals still on his feet, the Gorgon's face turned away from the viewer.

artworks.title: Perseus and Andromeda
artworks.description: Burne-Jones' chain of canvases follows the princess on the rock and the hero descending with the petrifying trophy — Ethiopia's rescue painted in the same Pre-Raphaelite register as the Gorgon quest.
